description: This file defines classes and methods for CRM segmentation in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including segmentation rules and criteria evaluation.

classes.name: crm_segmentation
classes.description: Defines CRM segmentation logic, including processing and rule management.

classes.name: crm_segmentation_line
classes.description: Defines individual segmentation criteria and evaluation logic.

methods.name: process_continue
methods.description: Processes segmentation continuation, assigning categories to partners based on criteria.

methods.name: process_stop
methods.description: Stops the segmentation process, setting status to 'not running'.

methods.name: process_start
methods.description: Starts the segmentation process, setting status to 'running'.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Evaluates a segmentation criterion against a partner's data.
